title: E0067: Mail injection
plain_english: This rule reports mail-sending calls where user-controlled input reaches mail headers, subject, or related arguments. Crafted input can inject additional mail headers.
why_matters: Mail injection can allow attackers to abuse a contact form or mail feature to send spam, spoof headers, or add unintended recipients.
what_it_checks: Cases where user-controlled input reaches these calls, based on taint analysis and dynamic-expression heuristics
